findings.evidence: template/scripts/model_routing.py run_claude_sandboxed calls launch(argv, checkout, integration_root=..., platform_root=..., workdir=root, home=home, tmp=tmp, config=..., runner=runner) with no `timeout`. launch_sandboxed_writer defaults to timeout=None and passes it to run_llm. The probe script passes timeout=900.
findings.summary: The sandboxed Claude dispatch launches the writer without a timeout, although the launch primitive accepts one. A hung writer blocks the supervisor indefinitely.

findings.evidence: run_claude_sandboxed creates `workdir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dp-sandboxed-claude-"))` and builds the checkout. When launch raises SandboxedWriterError, it is converted to RoutingError. dispatch_claude_sandboxed then closes the delegation as not-launched and re-raises without removing the workdir. The workdir is removed only on the `completed` outcome.
findings.summary: A pre-launch refusal leaves the disposable workdir behind. That workdir holds a full copy of the task worktree, including uncommitted state, and nothing removes it.
